shellCommands.command: cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/SKILL.md && echo "=== TREE ===" && find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -type f -print | head -100 && echo "=== PKG ===" && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; cat AGENTS.md

echo "=== ROUTING TOP ===" && sed -n 1,80p .agents/skills/gravity-ui/references/package-routing.md && echo "=== TRAPS ===" && cat .agents/skills/gravity-ui/rules/hallucination-traps.md && echo "=== SRC ===" && cat src/App.tsx src/main.tsx index.html tsconfig.json vite.config.ts && echo "=== INSTALLED ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/ 2>/dev/null; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep '"version"'; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
timeout 60 npm view @gravity-ui/page-constructor version peerDependencies 2>&1 | head -40

timeout 300 npm install @gravity-ui/page-constructor @diplodoc/transform 2>&1 | tail -15 && grep '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/ && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs 2>/dev/null | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && echo "=== INDEX ===" && cat build/docs/INDEX.md | head -150 && echo "=== README setup ===" && rg -n -i -C 6 'required setup|getting started|import .*styles|PageConstructorProvider' README.md | head -120 && echo "=== BLOCK FILES ===" && ls build/docs/blocks build/docs/sub-blocks build/docs/guides

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs && echo "=== HEADER ===" && cat blocks/Header.md && echo "=== CARDLAYOUT ===" && cat blocks/CardLayout.md && echo "=== BASICCARD ===" && cat sub-blocks/BasicCard.md
echo "=== BANNER ===" && cat blocks/Banner.md && echo "=== CONTENTLAYOUT ===" && cat blocks/ContentLayout.md && echo "=== CONTENT sub ===" && cat sub-blocks/Content.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && echo "=== sass? ===" && ls node_modules/sass/package.json node_modules/sass-embedded/package.json 2>&1; echo "=== dynamic imports in build ===" && rg -l 'import\(' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm --glob '*.js' | head; echo "=== vite plugin note ===" && rg -n -i 'vite' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/README.md node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/docs/INDEX.md | head; echo "=== styles entry ===" && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/styles/ && grep -n '"exports"' -A 30 node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/package.json | head -50

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && echo "=== VITE NOTE ===" && sed -n 510,532p README.md && echo "=== STYLES EXPORT ===" && rg -n '"\./styles' package.json && echo "=== TYPES ===" && rg -n 'export (interface|type) (PageContent|ButtonProps|ButtonTheme|GravityIconProps|PageConstructorProps)\b' -A 12 build/esm/models/*.d.ts build/esm/*.d.ts build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -120 && echo "=== gravityIcon resolve ===" && rg -n 'gravity-ui/icons' -l build/esm | head -5 && echo "=== PROVIDER theme ===" && rg -n 'theme' build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructorProvider.d.ts | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && grep '"version"' icons/package.json && for n in Clock ChartColumn Persons PersonsLock Rocket Calendar CircleCheck Stopwatch Timer ArrowRight; do ls icons/esm/$n.js >/dev/null 2>&1 && echo "OK $n" || echo "MISSING $n"; done; ls icons/esm | head -3

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor && echo "=== common.d.ts types ===" && rg -n 'export (interface|type) (ButtonProps|ButtonTheme|GravityIconProps|ThemedGravityIconProps)\b' -A 14 build/esm/models/constructor-items/common.d.ts | head -90 && echo "=== utils/icons.js ===" && cat build/esm/utils/icons.js && echo "=== PROVIDER ===" && ls build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/ && rg -n 'theme|ssrConfig|isMobile' build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/PageConstructorProvider*.d.ts build/esm/containers/PageConstructor/*.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head

sed -i "s|alias: \[{ find: /^~(@gravity-ui\\\\/)/, replacement: '\$1' }\],|alias: [{ find: /^~(?=@)/, replacement: '' }],|" vite.config.ts && sed -i 's|styles use webpack-style "~@gravity-ui/..." imports|styles use webpack-style "~@scope/pkg" imports|' vite.config.ts && cat vite.config.ts && echo "=== BUILD ===" && timeout 300 npm run build 2>&1 | tail -15

timeout 300 npx vite build 2>&1 | grep -v '^\s*at ' | head -12; echo "=== url polyfill ===" && cat node_modules/url/package.json 2>/dev/null | grep -E '"(version|main|browser)"'; grep -n '"url"' package-lock.json | head -3; echo "=== pc url.js usage ===" && grep -n "format\|parse" node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/utils/url.js | head

rg -n 'anchor' node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/BlockBase/BlockBase.js node_modules/@gravity-ui/page-constructor/build/esm/components/Anchor/Anchor.js 2>/dev/null | head -8; echo "=== STATUS ===" && git status --short && echo "=== package.json deps ===" && grep -A 12 '"dependencies"' package.json && grep -n '"url"' package.json
